history.detail: Chicken + broccoli + ziti in a light lemon-broth-parmesan sauce with artichokes. Live chicken-divan is a broccoli cheese BAKE and hot-honey-chicken bowls are rice+honey; no live chicken-broccoli PASTA. Kept but flagged borderline: shares chicken/skillet/pasta with the also-accepted mushroom-chicken-pasta and adds to catalog chicken-pasta density, though the broccoli/lemon/artichoke profile is a genuinely different plate from mushroom-cream farfalle. 37g protein, strong batch main.
